statement.p: If the gradient of f is \nabla f = 2x\,\mathit{\vec i}+z^{2}\,\mathit{\vec j}+3yz\,\mathit{\vec k} and the point P = (-2, 7, 2) lies on the level surface f(x, y, z)=0, find an equation for the tangent plane to the surface at the point P.

static.solution: P=(-2,7,2) we have \mbox{grad}\, f = -4\,\mathit{\vec i}+4\,\mathit{\vec j}+42\,\mathit{\vec k}. Hence the tangent plane to the level surface f(x, y, z)=0 at the point P is given by the equation 4\mathopen{}\left(y-7\right)-4\mathopen{}\left(x+2\right)+42\mathopen{}\left(z-2\right) = 0, or z = 2-\frac{4\mathopen{}\left(y-7\right)-4\mathopen{}\left(x+2\right)}{42}.
